dialogues.speaker: Letter from the Supervisor
dialogues.text: "...Please rest assured, Ms. Grazina. I will do everything in my power to ensure that those injured in the monster attack receive the most appropriate treatment..."

dialogues.speaker: Letter from the Supervisor
dialogues.text: "...As for the children who have unfortunately fallen ill, I will instruct the medical department to spare no effort in their care. We will, of course, not abandon a single one of our comrades..."

dialogues.speaker: Letter from the Supervisor
dialogues.text: "...However, before eliminating those detestable monsters, I intend to release them into our experimental area to test the purifying effects of your new plant strains..."

dialogues.speaker: Letter from the Supervisor
dialogues.text: "...I'm sure you understand that this is for the greater good. I give you my word, in my own name, that such containment breaches will not happen again..."
